get_security_alert.name: get_security_alert
get_security_alert.description: Retrieve the initial security incident/alert, including severity, affected identity or resource, detection time and observed indicators. Use this to establish investigation scope before deeper analysis.

incident_id.description: Security incident identifier, for example SEC-2026-001.

get_cloudtrail_events.name: get_cloudtrail_events
get_cloudtrail_events.description: Retrieve CloudTrail-like AWS API activity for an identity or resource over a recent time window. Use this to investigate who performed which API actions, from where, and whether sensitive or unusual AWS operations occurred.

principal.description: IAM principal, role, user, or session to investigate.

get_security_findings.name: get_security_findings
get_security_findings.description: Retrieve correlated GuardDuty/Security Hub-style security findings for an asset or principal. Use this to identify detections, severity, suspicious behavior and affected resources that may support or challenge a threat hypothesis.

resource.description: Resource, workload, or principal for which security findings should be retrieved.

get_vulnerability_findings.name: get_vulnerability_findings
get_vulnerability_findings.description: Retrieve Inspector-style vulnerability findings for a workload or software component. Use this to determine whether known vulnerabilities materially affect the incident risk or attack path.

resource.description: Workload, image, instance, package, or resource to inspect for vulnerabilities.

review_security_code.name: review_security_code
review_security_code.description: Review a named deployment/configuration artifact for predefined security weaknesses such as excessive IAM permissions, unsafe secret handling, public exposure, or insecure configuration. Use this when code or configuration may have enabled the security incident.

artifact_name.description: Name of the code, IAM policy, deployment template, or configuration artifact to review.

get_security_playbook.name: get_security_playbook
get_security_playbook.description: Retrieve approved security investigation and remediation guidance for a threat or weakness. Use this before recommending or requesting containment/remediation so the response follows enterprise security procedure.

topic.description: Security threat, weakness, or remediation topic to look up.

request_security_remediation.name: request_security_remediation
request_security_remediation.description: Request a controlled security remediation such as disable_credentials, restrict_iam, quarantine_workload, rotate_secret, or block_public_access. The lab does not execute high-impact production changes; it returns the approval requirement. Use only after evidence and playbook guidance support the action.

target.description: Identity, workload, resource, or configuration targeted by remediation.

reason.description: Evidence-based reason for the remediation request.
